home.bio: Technology, security and architecture leader with 25 years of experience shaping strategy, architecture and transformation across cybersecurity, cloud and critical 24/7 environments. Experienced in setting technology direction, shaping investment priorities, establishing governance and operating models, and aligning senior stakeholders around executable transformation roadmaps. At Schneider Electric, built the global cloud security strategy, secured €nM in executive funding and led a N-project transformation program, with reported incidents falling 30% over 24 months. At AWS, led security and cloud transformation engagements for major regulated organizations across EMEA. Today, lead Enterprise Security Architecture & Cloud Security for a 24/7 IoT environment serving nM+ customers across N countries.

experience.context: Many millions of customers | Tenths of countries | AWS & Azure | AI | 24/7 mission-critical IoT | Cloud, edge & on-prem.
highlights: Set cloud security direction across AWS and Azure, defining enterprise requirements, reference architectures and guardrails for enterprise cloud adoption and transformation.

Led the enterprise selection of the strategic XXX platform, defining the RFI/RFQ, assessment criteria and competitive evaluation across three vendors; XXX was selected and is now being deployed across the cloud estate.
Shape the security and resilience strategy for the modernization of mission-critical alarm-processing services spanning cloud, edge and on-premises environments.
Additional strategic assignments across AI, cloud, privacy and risk governance, subject to confidentiality obligations.

experience.context: Founded and ran an independent architecture practice delivering technology transformation, cloud, cybersecurity and industrial IoT engagements across financial services, energy, aviation and industry. Created a cryptographic data-protection product whose IP was acquired.
highlights: European enterprise payments technology company (Germany): Designed an AWS infrastructure migration strategy including a new landing zone and a CNAPP tool, then executed the migration of 16 apps and hundreds of microservices to AWS in under 9 months.

Major European energy utility (Spain): Redesigned the architecture service model supporting a large-scale Azure-to-AWS migration, improving how architecture supported cloud agility, decision-making and migration delivery.

Major European energy utility (UK): Acted as cloud architect and IoT subject-matter expert on industrial IoT initiatives, including smart electricity-metering projects and their cloud integration with corporate apps.
Major European airline (Spain): Domain architect for Customer Experience, Loyalty and Payments; defined the target architecture adopted as the reference for three delivery teams.

Industrial OT/ICS MSSP (Spain): Designed an AI-assisted anomaly-detection architecture combining eBPF telemetry with local AI inference and selective escalation to more capable models, balancing detection depth, latency, privacy, bandwidth, resilience and cloud AI cost.

experience.role: Security Team Leader – Global Financial Services
experience.context: EMEA | Multiple tier-1 banks + regulated enterprises | C-suite stakeholders | 4-person specialist team.
highlights: Led security and cloud transformation engagements for major regulated organizations across EMEA, working directly with Directors, VPs and C-suite stakeholders on migration, modernization and risk decisions.
Led and developed a four-person security specialist team across concurrent customer transformation engagements.
Built and led a 12-week technical capability program for two consecutive years, upskilling 50+ professionals while maintain-ing customer delivery responsibilities.
Owned the security architecture for a competitive tier-1 European banking opportunity, resolving critical security and data-protection objections and contributing to AWS winning the evaluation.
Led security delivery for a top-tier African bank replatforming, coordinating five partner engineers to migrate N applications to AWS in five weeks using the AWS migration framework.

Delivered security architecture across cryptography, data protection, microsegmentation, data migration, data platforms, MLOps and early generative-AI use cases, translating regulatory and security requirements into executable technical roadmaps and implementation plans.

experience.role: Cloud Security Architect (CCoE) & Digital Risk Leader
experience.context: Global | 100+ countries | Multi-million EUR program | Multiple initiatives | AWS & Azure | 4-person core team.
highlights: Identified the absence of a coordinated global cloud security model and established Schneider Electric's first enterprise cloud security strategy, charter and transformation roadmap.
Built the business case, secured €nM in executive funding and translated the strategy into a portfolio of N initiatives, leading execution with a core team of four people.

Established common requirements for identity, data protection, governance, CSPM and workload protection, aligned with ISO 27001 and applicable NIS requirements while supporting the agility of the wider cloud transformation.
Defined KPIs and management dashboards to track execution, project progress and security posture, reporting periodically to senior leadership; 30% reduction in reported incidents over 24 months.
